refusals.G2-377: fi REFUSES the whole cursive-writing family: OPS 2014 removed kaunokirjoitus (joined handwriting) from Finnish schools from autumn 2016 — children learn tekstaus (print) and keyboard writing, and there is no Finnish school joined script nor a matching Playwrite FI font; a DK/NO/US script labelled Finnish would teach letterforms no Finnish teacher uses.
